articles.summary: Caesarstone Ltd. (NASDAQ: CSTE), a leading developer and manufacturer of high-quality engineered surfaces, today announced that it has rescheduled the release of its earnings results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 to allow additional time for settlement discussions related to current legal proceedings. The Company now plans to release its results on Wednesday, November 11, 2026 before the market opens. The release was previously scheduled for Wednesday, November 4, 2026. The Company will host a webcast and conference call on the same day at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss the results. The live webcast can be accessed through the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at ir.caesarstone.com . For those unable to access the webcast, the conference call will be accessible domestically or internationally, by dialing 1-833-816-1463 and 1-412-542-4167, respectively. The toll-free Israeli number is +972 3-374-1008. Upon dialing in, please request to join the Caesarstone
articles.title: Caesarstone Reschedules Third Quarter 2026 Results and Conference Call to November 11, 2026
